spec.name: Quiet names v19
spec.notes: Long the calm names, short the jumpy ones.

claim.text: Research-period backtest: Sharpe 1.6, annual return 8%, maximum drawdown 5%.

verdict.opinion: The strategy has a very limited research period with only 1 trial and no data reviewed. This creates a knife-edge problem where the performance could be due to luck rather than skill. The lack of transparency and data review raises concerns about the reliability of the claimed performance.
